extra.prompt:
Photorealistic product photography of the exact handheld device shown in the attached reference images — same shell, same proportions, same materials (glossy translucent amethyst-purple plastic with the internal PCB visible through it), same parting seam. Warm cream seamless background, soft drop shadow, consistent with the references. Do not add, remove, move or restyle any element of the device. No text overlays, no props, no people.

Take the attached side-view generation and clean its silhouette so that the ENTIRE outline is perfectly smooth and continuous: delete every round knob, bump, nub, wheel and protrusion sticking out of the left or right contour — there must be NONE. This is the right side of the device, which is completely plain: the only feature on this edge is the thin horizontal parting seam line; the shell surfaces above and below it are smooth and uninterrupted, with a gently convex crown at the top and a softly domed back. No control, button, switch, wheel, dial, knob, port or hole anywhere on this edge. Keep everything else identical: vertical tall-narrow profile orientation, framing, lighting, warm cream background, floating pose and proportions.
